The emotional sting of tech stack churn

Last week, it came to light that a large migration had mostly finished. The change became a central focus of discussion after the release, and the surrounding argument deserves careful attention.

Why This Matters More Than It Used To

A narrative used to come with friction because it could not outrun the argument. Lower execution costs have changed how quickly technical verdicts circulate.
